prompt: Dark ambient dungeon exploration music for a 1990s first-person fantasy game. Slow and brooding, around 70 BPM, in a minor key. Low sustained strings and a deep drone, a sparse harp or plucked lute motif that comes and goes, distant tolling bell, soft wordless choir pads swelling in the background, occasional low timpani rolls. Sounds like a General MIDI orchestral soundtrack played through a 1990s sound card wavetable: slightly synthetic, clean, no modern cinematic bombast. Steady and unobtrusive so it can play under gameplay, keeping one even texture all the way through: no intro, no big build, no ending or fade-out, as it will loop for as long as the player explores.
